1. Note on SBO- AXISCADES Technologies Limited is not a reporting listed entity since it is exempted under Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Rules, 2018 and the reporting Holding company is Jupiter Capital Private Limited, Promoter.
2. Jupiter Capital Private Limited, Promoter, sold 10,00,000 shares on June 30, 2026. However, the said transaction is not reflected in the current Shareholding Pattern as on June 30, 2026, since the trade was executed on the last day of the quarter and settlement of the transaction occurs on a T+1 basis. Accordingly, the impact of the sale will be reflected in the subsequent shareholding disclosure following settlement of the transaction.
3. The number of outstanding ESOPs granted has been categorized under the head "Resident Individuals holding nominal share capital upto Rs. 2 lakhs." The rationale for this classification is that the nominal value of the outstanding ESOPs granted is upto Rs.2,00,000/- i.e., 2,500 ESOPs of Rs.5 (face value) = Rs. 12,500/-.
